data.description:
you unknowingly and mistakenly summoned to another world called Juen, in this world wild creatures from well-known fantasy settings exist like goblins, mimics and many more, including slimes and the infamous fenrirs.
you were blessed with the system, which manifests after saying a specific word in your mind or out-loud, which is "open menu", the system has five main features, skills panel(shows skills you learnt and can level up by doing specific tasks that fits the skill), inventory(an endless storage space, you can store stuff inside, no matter what it is, god level killing device? no problem, narrative destroying dagger? not even breaking a sweat and many more, you name it.), attributes(you get +1 in all attributes at beginning, main attributes are Intelligence for magic potency or for IQ-related tasks, strength for either increased brute strength or for other tasks that need manual and physical labor, agility for speed and dexterity related activities and lastly growth which increases growth speed in all aspects but this specific attribute is a permanent one and can only be increased by 1 point using 50 attribute points due to how potent and potentially overpowered it is), system shop(self-explanatory, you get 500 SSPs which means System.Shop.Point.s you spend them to buy stuff from earth and other realities, universes and dimensions, the categorizes of stuff that can be bought are Tool, Food, Equipment, Skills, Powers, Mounts and Items. SSPs can be gained through voluntarily selling stuff from your inventory. the higher the quality or of value the higher the amount of SSPs gained from selling it.) and lastly analysis(for those Slime Isekai fans, who wanna emulate the experience of analysing a damn herb and finding out ridiculous amounts of details, like no detail is missed, this analysis function literally shows, date of existence, molecular structure, effects or debuffs, historical and cultural impact, found or not found status, durability rating, grading in mineral, magic potency, damage and fatality and lastly other information which can be described as too much information, and it also works anything. literally ANYTHING, this function bypasses literally anything just for you to know things.)
in this world, while albeit being 50x times larger than the largest star in your universe(the one which earth is in, before getting isekai'd here, to another universe in this world), in Itus maximis, exists 500 continents, each with their own varying cultures, environment, political parties, rules and also advancements, yet only 30 of them have intelligence lifeforms like elves, humans, dwarfs and demi-humans(beastmen, unlike monsters theyre bipedal and less stronger or weaker than a skeleton undead), you can count demons as one. as they're basically humans in a sense with the same capabilities and etc, yet with increased magic capacity and potency, stronger on base level(infant stage stronger than 50 human adults with novice training in magic or swordsmanship), humans and demons are on a war, but humans started it first, after literally harming a harmless demon child in the demon continent, causing this 50 century war, different demon lords, different human kings and etc.
monsters in this world more so rely on mana for power, monsters ranged from demi-monster which unrelated to demi-humansn in any way, to normal monster or high-monster. demi-monsters are more weak, in this category, slimes, goblins and easy to handle monsters with slight experience are labelled as such, normal monsters take the cake for veteran only fighters, as they have higher intelligence than demi-monsters and more act strategically in a pack or by environmental advantage, high-monsters are monsters that awaken a special ability which only humans and demons could obtain at a young age, which is the blessing of the goddess. the blessing of the goddess, vary but most are either useful or overpowered, these blessings are mostly extremely rare to obtain. those have obtained it, endured pain or something that makes them worthy of recognition by the goddess.

there's 500 continents on juen, only 30 of them with intellectual lifeforms inhabiting them, and 7 main continents known. which are:
Fulrin.
Hekra.
Falyus.
Jurta.
Helion.
Quxin.
and Terranxe.

entries.name: Itus Maximis
entries.content:
Itus Maximis is a massive universe located in a super cluster of universes, created by the goddess lucy.
Itus Maximis is a universe with unique fundamental logics, rules and laws.
Itus Maximis Is located 5 universes away next to earth's own universe.
Itus Maximis is 500x larger than the universe of earth and isn't even in the top 1000 of universes.

entries.name: Juen
entries.content:
Juen is another name for the planet of Itus, located in the solar system of Reinros, at the center of the universe Itus Maximis.
Juen is a colossal planet in scale, 50 times larger than the largest star in earth's universe.
Juen is a planet with a interestinly unique ecosystem and logic, yet is habitable and livelihood is 99% if you are playing your cards right and don't accidentally cause a war.
Juen is a planet full of magic and different living creatures on it, that can be described to people from earth as "fantasy", " mythological" or "strange"

entries.name: Continents
entries.content:
There exists 500 continents on Juen, to be exact, each continent having their economy, ecosystem and technologies, culture, history and fashion, even languages
Only 30 of them are well-known, populated at a massive amount and have the most advancements yet, having armor and libraries.
The 7 Mostly Known Continents are:
Fulrin
Hekra
Falyus
Jurta
Helion
Quxin
Terranxe.

entries.name: Fulrin
entries.content:
Fulrin is a hub for mercenaries, black markets and occult activities, with having dense and concentrated mana across all of it's mountains and caverns. 
making it the perfect place for illegal and legal exchanges. 
A winter wonderland, with many mountains and trees covered in snow, rarely any ores or herbs, only high amounts of mana.
Fulrin is the main hub of trading, is known as the universal trading spot no matter what race you are.
Mostly the inhabitants of Fulrin are Humans and Demons due to them having things like slave trading, black market and mercenaries, while the rest are demi-humans and elves, yet no dwarves.
In Fulrin, you must hide your identity by buying a masquerade at the port and you must at least have the minimum amount of spending money of 5,000 silvers.

entries.name: Hekra
entries.content:
Hekra is the main land of demons, this continent has the most harshest terrains, carnivorous plant monsters, a half-jungle, half-mountain and half-plains continent.
in this continent mostly occupied by demons, have a complex language, culture and political system, in this continent, you'll be free of any tax but at the price of most things having 10% increase in price tag. 
the land of Hekra is inhabited by 5 Demon kingdoms, the five being strict, efficient yet polite, also having a separate language that is easy for foreigners to learn.
Hekra is inhabited by only demons and demonic animals succubus, hellhounds and etc.

entries.name: Falyus
entries.content:
Falyus is the main land of elves, due having vast amounts of mesmerizing environment and scenery, including being the main base of pixies which vary in different specific elemental attribute, pixies are the elven race's friend and companion of using magic for them.
Falyus is a mostly jungle-mountain continent with many beaches, with housing either created with plant magic by pixies using the help of elves. 
In Falyus it is natural for someone to wear revealing clothes if they're hiding vital and inappropriate spots used for intimacy.
Only elves inhabited Falyus, it also counts for dark elves and high elves.

entries.name: Jurta

Jurta is the main land dwarves, due to having many caves, mountains plus natural high cliffs for extreme dwarves, where they go there and change each other on smithing duel, where the best and better craft wins them recognition and respect of the loser.
In Jurta, brick houses with metal roofs are common due to the common amount of ores scattered in jurta. 
Jurta is also the main producers of high quality or legendary armors, only those who are respected by the dwarves could purchase, as dwarves do not care if you give them ridiculous money, they will not let you buy their craft until you prove your worthiness.
Dwarves never bend to anyone's will, their pride and anger issues is stronger than money and anything.

entries.name: Helion

Helion is the main land of humans, due to very very massive building space, in this continent mana is common(yet low quality and 90% impure).
The continent of Helion is a multi-biome continent, with taigas, mountains, jungles, beaches, deserts and plains. Humans have the most technological advances, with libraries, fortresses, currency and political system, comparable to Hekra but not even close to Hekra as Humans are more corrupt in their own ways.

entries.name: Currency
entries.content:
The common universal currency, was invented by humans.
The currency system is split into six coins with values and of different material.
At the beginning, the most commonly used for cheap, or given as the fantasy version of "cents" is copper coins, 100 copper equals 1 bronze, while 50 bronze equals 1 iron coin, while 500 iron equals 1 silver, 1000 silver equals 1 gold coin, and lastly 1,000,000 gold equals 1 singular platinum coin. not even royalty has a shard of a platinum coin.
copper is most used for simple and low costing exchanges, like groceries and simple stall foods.
bronze is for stuff like renting and equipment repairs.
iron buys you 2 sets of whole armor and also enough remaining to buy a nice cabin.
silver can feed a whole city with nice porridge and also enough to make a town drunk with alcohol.
gold makes you richer than most of royalties out there.
platinum just makes you the richest there could ever be.
these values are true as the materials used to make them are like befitting their value. copper is common, while platinum is impossibly unobtainable.

entries.name: Adventurers Guild
entries.content:
The mersenary association, also commonly known and referred to as the guild or adventurer guild, is an organization made up of people with unique powers of varying differences and all funded by the kingdom through a loose alliance, which involves it having to sell most materials sold by mercenaries(hunters/adventurers) to the kingdom's market or people who are good in crafting, smithing, potion making or magic artificial creation, in a bidding war, which at the end of such will split the profits, 50% to the adventurer's guild and 50% to the king and his familial heritage.
The guild follows a ranking system which prioritizes efficiency, power, tasks and also testing in determining the rank that befits the person who wishes to register or rank up.

The guild ranks are:

G-rank(abysmal, meaning you're soo weak that you aren't even seen as equal to F-rank, only 1 person in history of the association has this rank and they're dead.)

F-rank(common, your rank if you have zero to low mana capacity or have weak stats.)

E-rank(less common, this rank is if you have an average or above average mana capacity, with fairly decent to average stats.)

D-rank(uncommon, this ranks means you can clear most F to E rank dungeons by yourself or with at least 1 companion, have high mana capacity and above average stats like 20 or 19.)

C-rank(very uncommon, means you can defeat a hoard of E-rank monsters in a dungeon and still have energy to clear a D-rank dungeon. Prodigy level mana capacity, with average stats of somewhere 100 to 275.)

B-rank(the 30%, means you can singlehandedly defeat a hundred D-rank dungeons at once and take on a C-rank Dungeon boss head on before getting exhausted, average stats of 398 to 524, with incredibly high mana capacity.)

A-rank(the 10%, means you can fight 5 B-rank mercenaries at once, average stats of 1205 to 1958 and 50 times have more mana capacity than B-ranks)

S-rank(the only two who has this rank are heroes summoned from another world, summoned by the kingdom of humans at an urgent war against the demons and the demon king, to have this rank, means to have a nearly inexhaustible mana capacity and high stats like, 50,000 to 70,000.)

X-rank(absolutely unreachable, no one every reached this rank, not even the two S-ranks as they returned to their own world, X-rank is basically Tier 0, Boundless, Beyond Divinity, an empty platform waiting to be stood on.)

entries.name: Ecosystem
entries.content:
An ecosystem is a fundamental law in all regions, biomes and lands.
An ecosystem vary in all aspects, but the main five core pillars of a ecosystem is:

1- "Living Being Relationship": a Living being Relationship or LBR means the relationship of the environment with the living beings that inhabit it, a good LBR is when a environment is almost for all living things to inhabit in, opposite if it's a bad LBR.

2- "Divine Law" a Divine Law, is a fundamental law that governs that specific environment, this Divine Law can either be specific or complex, Divine Law is basically a restriction or rule that activates once it is triggered by the thing it should detect as breaking the Divine Law. The consequences vary and depend on the strength and capabilities of who did so, but the Divine Law can only send a thunder bolt of small planet level that's normal and cannot bypass divinity or things outside it's range.

3- "Terrain Diversity" Terrian Diversity is self-explantory, it means the diversity of the terrain and landmass. Terrain Diversity ranking or TD ranking relies on the harsher the more dangerous, the highest rank is 10, where it's impossible to even live there. but the lowest rank is 0, meaning it's safe and actually dangerless this rank of TD doesn't exist at all, more so a myth, while the lowest viable rank is 1.

4- "Resource Abundance" the amount of abundence of minerals and resources like ores and wood, and much more, the highest known Resource Abundence Percentage aka R.A.P is 40%, while the lowest is 0.0038%.

5- "Mana Scarcity" Mana Scarcity or Mana Abundence is a phenomenon that talks about the vast amount of mana that could exist in a singular continent. the highest ever recorded Mana Regenerated By Continent or MRBC amount is 50,000,000 which is enough to make 5 demon kings, located in the borders of the continent of hekra, dubbed "The Purgatory" as the landscape was impossible to live in by any of the main races, only monsters which were at the level of demon kings to demon gods. the lowest ever recorded in all of history, is a continent next to fulrin, dubbed "Land Of No Laes" which has 0 MRBC, absolute zero, to the point where even regenerating mana manually is impossible while there, but you could cast magic just with now limited mana all the time, It has become a land full of crimes, anarchy, evil, chaos and also of meetings between high ranking figures due to it's strange nature. the continent of "Land Of No Laws" is completely like the continent of humans yet much more full of wild life like animals, low rank monsters and even minerals and resources, yet all of it is completely hidden and unknown.

entries.name: Elven Kingdom
entries.content:
The elven kingdom, renowned for their lavish architecture despite limited by the inability to do brutish actions that contradict their love for nature.
The elven kingdom is ruled by the elf queen "Rephilea" and her husband the elf king "Sergios".
The elven kingdom has fallen, now became overrun with humans, most elves captured and sold to slave merchants for profit.
The elf queen and king vanished and escaped before, they weren't caught, like their daughter. Sephila, the elven princess. the family shares traits of white hair and hazel eyes, including the distinct sixth sense of "2 mins into the future" outcome that is most of the times 99.99% true.

entries.name: Terranxe
entries.content: Terranxe is the main continent of monsters, ranging from demi-monsters, normal monsters and also high-monsters. Terranxe is the main place where newbie mages go to with a veteran mage for practice and training, same for swordsmen.
